blocks.title: Free alarms ring in Silent mode and Focus
blocks.text: Turn on Alarm for an item, and it rings like the Clock app. Remind Again sends up to 12 more reminders if you do not record the dose. Both are free.

blocks.title: Tap Taken on the reminder
blocks.text: Record a dose and leave Maru closed. The reminder also has Skip and Remind in 10 min, and the free widget shows your day.

blocks.title: See your next dose on the Lock Screen
blocks.text: With Maru Pro, Next Dose on Lock Screen shows your next dose with a Taken button.

blocks.title: For your family and your pets
blocks.text: With Maru Pro, add a person or a pet, such as a parent or your dog. Each one has a color. Records stay on your iPhone or iPad, with no shared profiles and no sync.

blocks.title: Months of records. No streaks.
blocks.text: See months at a glance, and the last seven days of every item. Forgot to record? Nothing happens. Maru has no streaks and no penalties.

blocks.title: Record doses on your Apple Watch
blocks.text: With Maru Pro, see your doses and record them from your wrist.

blocks.title: Your bottle, your icon
blocks.text: Take or choose a photo of your own bottle, and it becomes the item icon. Maru can remove the background on your iPhone or iPad, and the photo stays on your device.

faq.title: Maru: Questions and answers
faq.desc: Short answers about Maru: the price, Maru Pro, your data, reminders, and moving to a new iPhone or iPad.
items: Is Maru free?
Maru is free to download, with no ads. Reminders, alarms, Remind Again, records, History, undo, widgets, Export Records, and backups are free, with no limit on items. Maru Pro is optional.
What is in Maru Pro?

Next Dose on Lock Screen, the Apple Watch app, PDF reports for your doctor, 30-day counts, Family, app icons, reminder sounds, and app colors. In the US, the yearly plan costs $9.99 with a 7-day free trial. Lifetime costs $19.99 for the first 30 days after launch, then $29.99. Prices in other countries can be different. Family Sharing is on, and there is no monthly plan.
Do alarms ring in Silent mode and Focus?
Yes. Free alarms ring through Silent mode and Focus, like the Clock app. Turn on Alarm for each item. Alarms need iOS 26 or later. Silent mode or a Focus can hold a normal reminder.
Can I record from the reminder?

Yes, and Maru stays closed. A reminder for one item has Taken, Skip, and Remind in 10 min. When Show Names in Reminders is on, a reminder for several items has Take All, Skip All, and Remind in 10 min. With the names hidden, it has only Remind in 10 min.
Will Maru keep reminding me?
Turn on Remind Again for an item, or for all items in Settings. Maru sends up to 12 more reminders for a dose that you did not record.
Can I see my next dose on the Lock Screen?
Yes. With Maru Pro, Next Dose on Lock Screen shows your next dose with a Taken button. The free widgets also show your next dose.
Do I need an account?
No. Open Maru and add what you take.
Can I use Maru for a parent or a pet?

Yes. With Maru Pro, open Family in Settings and tap Add Person or Pet. Each person or pet has a color, and Today, History, and the PDF can show one of them. Records stay on your iPhone or iPad, with no shared profiles and no sync.
What if I forget to record?
You can record later or change the recorded time. Nothing else happens: Maru has no streaks and no penalties.
Is there an Apple Watch app?
Yes, with Maru Pro. The Apple Watch app shows your doses, and you record them from your wrist.
Where is my data?

Your items and records stay on your iPhone or iPad. Each device keeps its own data, and Maru does not sync between devices. The privacy page has the details. With Maru Pro, your iPhone sends the list of today to your own paired Apple Watch.
Why not the Clock app or Apple Health?
A Clock alarm rings, but it does not know what you took. Apple Health does much more. Maru does one small job: it shows what to take now, and one tap records it.
Can I take something every few days, or with a break?

Yes. Choose Every Day, Every Other Day, Every Few Days (every 3 to 30 days), or Days On and Off, for example 21 days on and 7 off. An As Needed item has no reminders, and you record it when you take it.
Does Maru tell me what to take?
No. Maru gives no medical advice: you enter what you take, and Maru reminds you.
Does Maru count the pills I have left?
No. Maru reminds and records, and nothing more.
Can I use a photo of my bottle?
Yes. On the add or edit screen, take or choose a photo, and it becomes the item icon. Maru keeps a small copy on your device and can remove the background there. Maru never sends the photo.
How do I move to a new iPhone or iPad?

In Maru's Settings on the old device, tap Back Up and save the file. On the new device, tap Restore from Backup and choose that file. This replaces the items and records already in Maru on that device. The file is not encrypted, so keep it private.
Can I get my records out?
Yes. In Settings, Export Records makes a file that Numbers and Excel can open. With Maru Pro, Share Medication List and Share Summary make a PDF. You choose where each file goes.
Which languages does Maru speak?
English, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Spanish, German, and Korean.

privacy.title: Maru: Privacy
privacy.desc: What Maru stores on your device, what it sends, and what it never does.
summary: Your items and records stay on your iPhone or iPad, and each device keeps its own data. Maru has no account and no server for them.
Simple usage statistics never include what you take, and one switch in Settings turns them off.
Maru has no ads, and it does not read your contacts or your location.
